cancel.title: Cancel order {{number}}?
cancel.body: Do this once you've agreed with the buyer and refunded them through your site. The order's sales will be reset.
cancel.inSplit: {{count}} sales are already in a split. They won't change, and the rikma will be told so you can settle the refund together.
cancel.inSplitOne: 1 sale is already in a split. It won't change, and the rikma will be told so you can settle the refund together.
cancel.restockHint: On by default when the order hasn't shipped
cancel.reason: What did you agree with the buyer?
cancel.holderOnly: Only {{name}} can cancel — they hold the money
cancel.failed: The cancellation didn't save. Try again.
cancel.pendingBody: No payment has arrived yet, so there's nothing to refund or restock — the order just closes. Say why, if you like.

sales.search: Search product or who holds the money

connect.apiBody: Two ways to connect a site to the rikma — everything it sells lands here automatically.
connect.donationHint: A donation is recorded as a sale and goes into the split like any income.
connect.starterTitle: A ready shop for your site
connect.starterBody: Catalog, variant picker, cart and payment with Stripe or PayPal — connected to the rikma. Deploy to Vercel or Netlify in one click, and every paid order lands here with its shipping details.
connect.starterEnvHint: The deploy asks for two values from the rikma — both are here:
connect.starterReplaceConfirm: The current key stops working right away, and a shop already using it will need the new one. Continue?
connect.starterSaveWarning: Copy the key now — it is shown only once. If you lose it, just create a new one.
connect.starterKeyScopes: The key gets only orders:create and orders:read, and lives only on the shop’s server (an environment variable) — never in the browser.
connect.starterKeyError: Creating the key failed. Please try again.
connect.starterDeployHint: The rikma address is already filled in on the Vercel or Netlify form. Create a key in step 1 and click here right after — the key gets filled in too. All that’s left is the details of the payment provider you chose.
connect.siteTitle: Already have a site? Report sales
connect.siteBody: A snippet your existing site sends after each checkout — one sale per payment. The key made here only reports sales and does not fit the ready-made shop.
connect.otherKeys: Need a key with other permissions (tasks, catalog)? All keys and permissions —
connect.starterDeployReady: The rikma address and the key will be filled in on the Vercel or Netlify form — all that’s left is the details of the payment provider you chose.

sp.stackLabel: Of {{total}}: {{split}} split, {{voting}} in a vote, {{waiting}} waiting
sp.flowsTitle: Who transfers to whom, if you split now
sp.voteLine: A split of {{amount}} is in a vote · {{yes}} of {{total}} approved · with no reply it is approved by silence when the rikma's response time ends
sp.emptyBody: No sales yet. Report the first one — it joins the split between the partners.

ww.openNote: A sale still waiting for its holder's consent stays out of the split until it is approved.
ww.pendingTitle: A split proposal was sent and is being approved
ww.silence: If nobody responds, the proposal is approved by silence when the rikma's response time ends.
ww.ssSub: 1💗1 joins the split as a service-providing partner. This amount is deducted from the profit shared between partners (left to split: {{left}} of {{total}}). Suggested: {{proposed}} - you may give more or ask for less; approved instantly.
ww.creatorSkipped: You chose not to give - saved when the split is created.
ww.creatorGives: Your contribution ({{amount}}) will be saved when the split is created.

pay.title: Is the payment for order {{number}} with you?
pay.body: Whoever confirms here holds the money: the sales are recorded in your name. If the buyer paid another partner, ask them to confirm.
pay.amountHint: Gave a discount on the phone? Enter what actually arrived.
pay.under: Less than the catalog price ({{amount}}) — the order will be marked as sold at a discount.
pay.confirm: Yes, the money is with me
pay.failed: The payment didn't save. Try again.
pay.holderOnly: This payment is already being recorded by {{name}}
